reportTitle: Phase 7A.6R4 Failure Settlement Classification & Drain Timeout Resource Safety Closure

fixF1_FailureSettlementMisclassification.description: Strict separation of non-cancellability from commit completion in DictionaryOperationManager and ActivationCoordinator, ensuring activation and metadata write failures settle as failed instead of misclassifying as completed.

mechanisms.commitBoundaryNonCancellableOnly: onCommitBoundary hook exclusively sets ctx.nonCancellable = true; committed = true is deferred until activateManagedDatabase() fully resolves without exception.
mechanisms.catchBlockClassification: Failure catch block settles as cancelled only when !committed && !ctx.nonCancellable && (signal.aborted || this.#isAbortError(error)); all post-commit and critical-section failures settle as failed.
mechanisms.rollbackPreservation: ActivationRollbackError preserves and logs both the primary activation error and secondary rollback failure messages without masking.
mechanisms.progressPercentIntegrity: Failed operations never report progress.percent = 100 or successful installation messages, guaranteeing GET /dictionary/status and lastOperation fidelity.

fixF2_UnsafeManagerClosureAfterDrainTime.description: Fail-closed concurrency serialization during Cordis plugin disposal, preventing premature DictionaryManager closure while background operations remain in flight.

mechanisms.synchronousClosureGuarded: Plugin unload disposer checks drained && !operationManager.isBusy() before synchronously calling manager.close().
mechanisms.deferredClosureOnTimeout: When drain times out or operations remain busy, manager closure is deferred via void operationManager.whenSettled().finally(() => manager.close()), keeping dependencies open until settlement.
mechanisms.coordinatorDisposalGuard: ActivationCoordinator tracks #disposed state; activateManagedDatabase throws AbortError if coordinator is disposed or manager is closed.
mechanisms.reDisposeTimeoutConsistency: DictionaryOperationManager.dispose() re-validates isBusy() and drainSummary.workflowSettled on repeated calls, throwing OperationDrainTimeoutError consistently rather than returning void.
mechanisms.aggregateErrorCollection: Independent disposer failures across routes and operations are aggregated into standard AggregateError.

verifiedInvariants.E2E-01: Unauthenticated route fence returning 401 on all management routes without DSH session
verifiedInvariants.E2E-02: Zero external network requests on initial boot, initial GET status query returning activeMode: fixture
verifiedInvariants.E2E-03: Protocol gating enforcing 405/404 method, 415 content-type, 413 body size <= 64 KiB, 400 forbidden parameters
verifiedInvariants.E2E-04: Concurrency mutex rejecting overlapping install/remove with 409, cancellation dispatch smoothly settling to cancelled
verifiedInvariants.E2E-05: Full streaming installation and live activation (770,611 entries, 57,689 forms) with non-fixture words hitting in ecdict-local
verifiedInvariants.E2E-06: Cross-process restart restoration verifying that subsequent DSH process restarts directly into managed-ecdict without re-download
verifiedInvariants.E2E-07: Settings sync state verification and schema compatibility across restart (settingsSyncState: synced)
verifiedInvariants.E2E-08: Safe removal releasing Windows SQLite locks, unlinking managed database, and hot-reverting queries to fixture
